notes: DRAFT from the bible v1.0 section 11. Location-type tags for designing lairs and dungeons: a dungeon is an ecosystem and a faction stronghold, not a row of combat rooms. Nothing here adds a dungeon boss (Canon section 6: a boss is an existing species) or an enemy hierarchy (Canon 4d). World events are region-level only and are proposals for the living-world event director, not yet registered there.

locationTypes.name: Dragon lair
locationTypes.signatureFeatures: Treasure vault, elemental hazards, flight spaces.

locationTypes.name: Insect hive
locationTypes.signatureFeatures: Caste chambers, pheromone zones, brood chambers.

locationTypes.name: Crystal cavern
locationTypes.signatureFeatures: Resonance puzzles, reflective attacks, mana fields.

locationTypes.name: Void rift
locationTypes.signatureFeatures: Spatial distortion, reality hazards, shifting rooms.

progression.text: Rumours, maps, guild contracts or environmental clues reveal the entrance.
The party chooses supplies, resistance gear, research and a retreat plan.
The party meets scouts, environmental hazards and early warning signs.
Defenders adapt, alarms trigger, reinforcements arrive or the dungeon changes.
Recover a relic, rescue captives, defeat a boss, close a rift or gather research.
Claim rewards, report to guilds, shift region state and change the area.

worldEvents.name: Goblin Warband Invasion
worldEvents.text: Multiple villages are threatened by a coordinated goblin host.

worldEvents.name: Dragon Migration
worldEvents.text: Draconic territories shift, disrupting trade routes and spawning rare hunts.

worldEvents.name: Undead Moon
worldEvents.text: Necromantic energy raises threats around graveyards and battlefields.

worldEvents.name: Insect Queen Awakening
worldEvents.text: A hive expands underground and threatens mines and towns.

worldEvents.name: Elemental Storm
worldEvents.text: A mana nexus destabilises, creating elemental outbreaks.

worldEvents.name: Leviathan Rising
worldEvents.text: Sea routes close and coastal guilds request a joint expedition.

worldEvents.name: Void Breach
worldEvents.text: Reality distortions spread and require a multi-guild containment effort.
